nerd-symbols.woff2 — bundled icon glyphs for the terminal mirror
================================================================

This file is a SUBSET of "FiraCode Nerd Font Mono" containing only the
icon glyphs (Unicode Private Use Area and related symbol ranges), so that
Nerd Font icons used by shells, prompts and TUIs render in the browser
terminal on any machine, whether or not a Nerd Font is installed locally.

It is used as a fallback font: normal text still renders in the primary
monospace font; only glyphs the primary font lacks fall through to this one.

The SIL Open Font License (OFL-1.1) permits bundling and redistribution of
the font (and subsets/derivatives) provided this notice is retained. Full
license text: https://openfontlicense.org

Regenerate this subset with:
  pyftsubset FiraCodeNerdFontMono-Regular.ttf \
    --unicodes="E000-F8FF,F0000-FFFFD,2500-259F,E0A0-E0D7" \
    --flavor=woff2 --desubroutinize --no-hinting \
    --layout-features='' --name-IDs='' --notdef-outline \
    --output-file=nerd-symbols.woff2
